title: PriVA single-family compatibility parameters
description: Documentation schema; required parameters and scientific input contracts are actively validated by main.nf and bin/priva_task.py.

input.description: Whole original cohort VCF; annotation keeps its complete sample context

vcf_index.description: Matching tabix index, defaults to input plus .tbi

ped.description: Original full PED; preserve family proband-first row order

cadd.description: Paired whole-cohort CADD TSV required for annotated mode

legacy_config.description: Explicit prepared legacy configuration; caches are not installed or remapped

resource_manifest.description: Frozen inventory generated by priva_task.py manifest

software_id.description: Pinned image digest or explicitly exported environment lock identity

vcf_hub_mode.description: A qualified hub must have identical cohort/control provenance; all hub writes target task-private copies
